name: Clover Steps
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #6 — a gentle descending stair: three trampoline islands stepping DOWN left-to-right (tops 1040/1080/1120) over two 580px gaps, plus one central bubblegum ledge as optional high ground. Teaches chaining two boosted hops in a row and reading a mild height change; the descending tops mean each rightward hop is a touch easier, the leftward return a touch harder — a soft directional gradient without any hazard.

GEOMETRY: A (trampoline x0..880 top1040) / B (trampoline x1460..2340 top1080) / C (trampoline x2920..3800 top1120), two 580px void gaps between them (A->B x880..1460, B->C x2340..2920). One bubblegum LEDGE (x1740..2060 top560 h48) hovers 520px above B. Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -540..4340 with ~540px side runway; bottom y1960 leaves 672-800px recovery sky.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~320 bubblegum; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 580 in <0.9s @ ~24 fuel; super 2800 clears all):
- GAP A->B and B->C: each 580px over open void. > 527 max spring drift and >> 395 trampoline drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED both ways; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the LEDGE (top560): 520px above B (1080). Trampoline apex 270 reaches only y810 -> 270px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: island bottoms (1168/1208/1248) to bottom blast (1960) = 712-792px recovery sky (>= 650). Verb: FLY.
- Every gap exceeds a spring bounce's reach and the ledge sits above spring apex, so flight is required. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
